response.query: Which expected-return models will be declared primary and which two alternatives (local banking index, currency-adjusted, FF-style) will be pre-registered for robustness?
response.answer: The primary expected-return model will be declared the Fama-French three-factor model, with the local banking index and currency-adjusted models as alternatives for robustness checks.

results.title: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network: Anti-Money Laundering ...
results.content: Additionally, FinCEN is expanding the exclusion from the AML/CFT program to also apply to (i) bank- and trust company-sponsored collective investment funds that comply with the requirements of [12 CFR 9.18](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-12/section-9.18) or a similar applicable law that incorporates the requirements of [12 CFR 9.18, and (ii)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-12/section-9.18#p-9.18(ii)) any other investment adviser subject to this rule that is advised by the investment adviser. In the IA AML NPRM released on February 15, 2024, FinCEN proposed to designate certain investment advisers as “financial institutions” under the BSA and subject them to AML/CFT program requirements and SAR filing obligations, as well as other BSA requirements.[[52](#footnote-52-p72160)]  Specifically, the IA AML NPRM would have added “investment adviser” to the definition of “financial institution” at [31 CFR 1010.100(t)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-31/section-1010.100#p-1010.100(t)), and then would have defined investment advisers to mean RIAs registered or required to register with, or ERAs that report to, the SEC.
